summary: Black Rock Forest tower, Orange County NY: NHLR gives a 1929 erection and 1933 build year, 80 ft Aermotor LS-42; a 2007 visit found no roof and no public access.

facts.design: Aermotor LS-42, 80 ft, with 7x7 metal cab (NHLR)
facts.status_note: NHLR 2007 visit report found no roof; FFLA lists it as standing with an asterisk that was not checked

access.note: Not accessible to the public; lower landing locked; entry by permission of the Forest Manager (2007 visit report)

visit.trail_note: Contact the Forest Manager at the Black Rock Forest office (2007 visit report)

events.note: Dr. Ernest G. Stillman established the forest (context for the tower's owner, not the tower itself)
NHLR description: erected in 1929 as a private lookout on the Stillman estate
NHLR Built field gives 1933; this conflicts with the 1929 erection date in the NHLR description
Ownership transferred to the Black Rock Forest Consortium
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register on December 15, 2006
Visit report dated May 1, 2007: no roof; staffed sometimes; not accessible to the public; entry by permission

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The NHLR description says the tower was erected in 1929; the NHLR Built field says 1933. Both are kept. No other source read settles which date is right.

notes_for_editor: Brief status_note says the cab is gone (FFLA). Not verified: the NHLR 2007 visit report says there is no roof and does not mention the cab, and the FFLA asterisk footnote was not read, so the cab claim is left out of the story. Brief access 'unknown' is answered by the 2007 NHLR visit report (entry by permission; not open to the public); that report is nearly 20 years old. Wikipedia's Black Rock Forest article also mentions an observation tower on the 1,402-foot Black Rock peak; it is not established that this is the NHLR tower (398 ft elevation), so it is not used. Searches found no construction or Stillman-era records for this tower.
